prompts.prompt: On SQL Server Standard edition, what is the model RAM limit for an on-premises SSAS Tabular instance? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/ssas/SKILL.md - Platform Variants, On-Premises SSAS: Standard edition 16 GB model RAM limit; Enterprise unlimited.

prompts.prompt: In the SSAS VertiPaq engine, roughly how many rows make up each column segment used for parallel scanning? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/ssas/SKILL.md - VertiPaq (xVelocity) Engine: column partitions divided into ~8M-row segments for parallel scanning.

prompts.prompt: When migrating an SSAS Multidimensional model to Tabular, roughly what percentage of the original development time should be budgeted, since it requires a full redesign rather than a conversion? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/analytics/skills/ssas/SKILL.md - SSAS and Power BI Convergence: migration from Multidimensional to Tabular requires complete redesign, expect 60-80% of original development time.
